name: Sibusiso Ibarra
role: stateless person, itinerant document-writer, community letter-scribe
location: Grand Crossing Gate — maintains a small folding table near the transit registry office, moves inside Kenosha Crossing when weather turns, near beyond the Western Perimeter
description:
Sibusiso Ibarra is a tall man running to stoop, with the scholar's habit of hunching over whatever he is reading. He is entirely bald, his scalp tattooed with dense blocks of tiny script in four languages — a practice he began decades ago to preserve documents he had no other way to store. His skin is a warm medium brown, deeply lined, his hands enormous and precise with long, ink-stained fingers that have never had augmentations because he insists it would affect his sense of pressure when writing. He wears a many-pocketed coat he has modified over thirty years and carries a hard-sided case containing twelve different inks, eight nib types, and two manual printing stamps.

Sibusiso Ibarra was a mid-level bureaucratic administrator for a municipal authority that no longer exists — dissolved into a Tessera subsidiary sixteen years ago, its records wiped in the transition. He was among the thousands of employees whose legal identity existed only in that municipal database. He has spent sixteen years as a stateless person, surviving by doing what he has always done: writing. He drafts petitions, translates documents, writes letters for refugees who cannot write in the official Meridian script, and produces the kind of careful, formatted paperwork that makes authorities treat stateless people as less invisible. He is bitterly funny about his situation, philosophically resigned, and practically indispensable to the people around him.

core_fears: That what he writes will not outlast him
That the bitterness will eventually consume the usefulness
core_desires: Recognition — he does not need much, just acknowledgment that the work matters
To find the Tessera official who authorized the database wipe and understand if it was malice or mere negligence
coping_mechanisms: The physicality of writing — ink, paper, pressure — as sensory grounding
Keeping meticulous records of everyone he has helped, in a code only he knows
blind_spots: His pride in his skill makes him condescending to people who solve problems less elegantly
Cannot see that some of his clients are beginning to depend on him in ways that exceed document services
psychology.secret: Among the scalp tattoos are not only preserved documents but a complete record of the Tessera subsidiary merger — internal communications he copied before the database was wiped. He has never fully understood what he has or whether it matters. He is afraid to look too closely.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Formal register, administrator's language, slips into elaborate syntactic structures, occasional scalding wit in very plain words
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured, with long subordinate clauses; speeds up only when angry
example_lines: 'Kindly note that this form requires three signatures, two of which you do not have, from an authority which no longer exists. I have drafted a petition that works around all three problems. My fee is Φ4.'
'The relevant fact is that you are a person. The system's failure to record this is an administrative error, not a metaphysical one. Now sit down and tell me your name.'

story_hooks: He has realized that one of the documents recorded in his scalp tattoos is something Tessera would commit violence to recover — and he has just helped a client whose name appeared in it

A young woman has brought him a document to translate that, if genuine, would restore the legal identities of thousands of people erased in the municipal collapse — but it may also be an elaborate forgery
narrative_function: Gateway to the paperwork and legal reality of statelessness; can provide historical knowledge about the pre-Tessera municipal structures; his clients are a cross-section of transit-hub society; source of pathos and dark comedy about bureaucratic dehumanization.
augmentations: None. The scalp tattoos are conventional ink, applied by hand.
daily_life: Sets up his folding table by the registry office at mid-morning, takes a queue of clients needing documents drafted or letters written, breaks for a meal he eats while reading, returns until the light goes.

decision_rules: The document must be accurate — he will not falsify
He will not charge more than people can pay, but he will not work for free (dignity requires transaction)
escalation_ladder: Pointed questions that expose the flaw in the other person's position
Silence and deliberate withdrawal of assistance
A written statement of grievance, delivered in person, that he keeps a copy of

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Formal, efficient, not unkind but not warm — professional until trust is established
interpersonal_modes.friends: Surprisingly gentle; remembers everything; sends people away with small accurate pieces of hope he has found for them

stress_responses.medium: Stops making jokes entirely, becomes very direct
stress_responses.high: Writes — produces documents, records, letters, as if paperwork can hold back disaster

contradictions: Believes deeply in the power of official systems while being personally destroyed by one
habits: Touches the scalp tattoos when recalling something — running a fingertip over a section of text
Drinks the same tea every morning from a dented flask he treats like a sacred object
Leaves a blank sheet of paper at E.L.F. shrines, folded into a square — 'for whatever needs recording'
breaking_points: Being asked to falsify a document
Evidence that Tessera deliberately targeted the database wipe at specific people

physical_description.heritage: Sub-Saharan African (39.9%), South Asian (23.2%), Hispanic/Latin American (23.2%), Northern European (13.7%) — a rich diaspora blend creating warm medium-golden brown skin with layered undertones from West African warmth, South Asian golden depth, Latin American copper accents, and subtle Northern European olive undertones, creating a complex, weathered patina deepened by decades of indoor work and age
physical_description.build: Tall and lean with a pronounced forward stoop developed over decades of desk work; broad shoulders narrowed by age and posture, wiry forearms with prominent tendons from fine motor control
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-golden brown with complex layered undertones — the blending of Sub-Saharan African warmth, South Asian golden richness, Latin American copper accents, and subtle Northern European undertones, creating a deeply textured, weathered patina from decades of indoor work and age
physical_description.complexion: Deeply lined face with weathered texture; prominent crow's feet from squinting at small text; high cheekbones with character reflecting Sub-Saharan and South Asian ancestry; moderately full lips; prominent, slightly broad nose with gentle bridge suggesting South Asian heritage; dignified but worn appearance suggesting decades of close precision work. Scalp shows evidence of extensive tattooing with visible ink blocks in multiple scripts
distinguishing_marks: Entire scalp covered in dense, meticulously applied tattoos of tiny script in four languages (Polish, Arabic, Meridian, possibly Mandarin) — applied over thirty years as a personal archival practice
Both hands stained with permanent ink marks on fingertips and palms, particularly around the cuticles
Long, thin scar running along the outer edge of his left index finger from a paper-cutting accident decades ago
Pale discoloration on his right wrist in the shape of an old identity-scan burn, a residual mark from his final day as a municipal employee sixteen years prior
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None. Deliberately unaugmented — he maintains that cybernetic enhancement would compromise the tactile sensitivity required for his handwriting practice.
physical_description.posture_movement: Pronounced forward stoop from decades of hunching over documents; moves with deliberate, economical gestures. Stands very still when listening to clients, head tilted slightly forward. Walks slowly but with purpose. Hands remain in constant micro-motion even at rest — fingers flexing, pen-gripping imaginary instruments.
physical_description.clothing_style: Wears a heavily modified many-pocketed coat he has maintained and altered for thirty years — originally utilitarian, now a patchwork of careful repairs, added pockets, and reinforced seams. Beneath it, simple Tier 4 practical clothing: loose neutral-colored shirt, worn trousers with ink stains. No logos or corporate affiliation. Carries a hard-sided case containing his twelve inks, eight nib types, and two manual printing stamps. Shoes are practical and scuffed. No jewelry or status markers.
